checks.title: Process can elevate its own privileges
checks.description: A program inside the container can elevate its own privileges and run as root.
checks.remediation: Set allowPrivilegeEscalation to false in the container SecurityContext.
messages: Container 'nginx' of ReplicaSet 'nginx-7c9d' should set allowPrivilegeEscalation to false

checks.title: Default capabilities not dropped
checks.description: The container should drop all default capabilities and add only those required.
messages: Container 'nginx' of ReplicaSet 'nginx-7c9d' should drop all capabilities

checks.title: Root filesystem is not read-only
checks.description: An immutable root filesystem can prevent malicious binaries being added to PATH.
messages: Container 'nginx' of ReplicaSet 'nginx-7c9d' should set readOnlyRootFilesystem to true
